about: Known cases for Full Reference Search: each must give the expected result. Run with [Run Tests] on the page, or: php do_full_reference_search.php _ '{"task": "run_tests"}'. Add a case whenever a problem is fixed. 'requires': skipped when that option is off. Cases 'dm-sheet-<identifier>' are rows of the Data Managers' Google Sheet "doi match tests" (Sheet1), whose DOIs were found by the Data Managers: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dtNG5qNIT_Y7E2JlR8QCboC1YWn6IwabMV9TQ2fJL4w/edit?gid=0 (Nov 19, 2026).
